mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS deviceTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN d.status_code = 'IN_USE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inUseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN d.status_code = 'MAINTAINING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS maintainingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN d.status_code = 'STOPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stoppedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN d.status_code = 'SCRAPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scrappedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN d.warranty_end BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warrantyExpiringCount, SUM(CASE WHEN d.create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS monthNewDeviceCount FROM device d WHERE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_maintenance m INNER JOIN device d ON m.device_id = d.id WHERE AND m.maintenance_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')

SELECT d.status_code AS code, COALESCE(dict.dict_name, d.status_code) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM device d LEFT JOIN sys_dict dict ON dict.dict_type = 'device_status' AND dict.dict_code = d.status_code AND dict.deleted = 0 WHERE GROUP BY d.status_code, dict.dict_name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT d.brand_code AS code, COALESCE(dict.dict_name, d.brand_code, '未分类') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM device d LEFT JOIN sys_dict dict ON dict.dict_type = 'device_brand' AND dict.dict_code = d.brand_code AND dict.deleted = 0 WHERE GROUP BY d.brand_code, dict.dict_name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT d.device_type_code AS code, COALESCE(dict.dict_name, d.device_type_code, '未分类') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM device d LEFT JOIN sys_dict dict ON dict.dict_type = 'device_type' AND dict.dict_code = d.device_type_code AND dict.deleted = 0 WHERE GROUP BY d.device_type_code, dict.dict_name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT CAST(d.department_id AS CHAR) AS code, COALESCE(dept.department_name, '未分配') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM device d LEFT JOIN sys_department dept ON dept.id = d.department_id AND dept.deleted = 0 WHERE GROUP BY d.department_id, dept.department_name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS code, p.project_name AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS value FROM project p INNER JOIN device_project dp ON dp.project_id = p.id INNER JOIN device d ON d.id = dp.device_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND GROUP BY p.id, p.project_name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT m.fault_type_code AS code, COALESCE(dict.dict_name, m.fault_type_code, '未分类') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM device_maintenance m INNER JOIN device d ON m.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN sys_dict dict ON dict.dict_type = 'fault_type' AND dict.dict_code = m.fault_type_code AND dict.deleted = 0 WHERE AND m.fault_type_code IS NOT NULL AND m.fault_type_code != '' GROUP BY m.fault_type_code, dict.dict_name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.maintenance_date, '%Y-%m') AS name, DATE_FORMAT(m.maintenance_date, '%Y-%m') AS code, COUNT(*) AS value FROM device_maintenance m INNER JOIN device d ON m.device_id = d.id WHERE AND m.maintenance_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(m.maintenance_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY name ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.maintenance_date, '%Y-%m') AS name, DATE_FORMAT(m.maintenance_date, '%Y-%m') AS code, COUNT(*) AS value, COALESCE(SUM(m.maintenance_cost), 0) AS amount FROM device_maintenance m INNER JOIN device d ON m.device_id = d.id WHERE AND m.maintenance_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(m.maintenance_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY name ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.warranty_end, '%Y-%m') AS name, DATE_FORMAT(d.warranty_end, '%Y-%m') AS code, COUNT(*) AS value FROM device d WHERE AND d.warranty_end IS NOT NULL AND d.warranty_end BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(d.warranty_end, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY name ASC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.supplier), ''), '未填写') AS code, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.supplier), ''), '未填写') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM device d WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.supplier), ''), '未填写') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.maintenance_company), ''), '未填写') AS code, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.maintenance_company), ''), '未填写') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM device d WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.maintenance_company), ''), '未填写') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.model), ''), '未填写') AS code, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.model), ''), '未填写') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM device d WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.model), ''), '未填写') ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.update_time, '%Y-%m') AS name, DATE_FORMAT(d.update_time, '%Y-%m') AS code, COUNT(*) AS value FROM device d WHERE AND d.status_code = 'SCRAPPED' AND d.update_time >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(d.update_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY name ASC
